english.title: Manufacturer/importer of civil explosives fail to inform authority of explosive presenting a risk
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[manufacturer]_
(B)_[importer]_

of a civil explosive which presented a risk, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVE..), failed to immediately inform the market surveillance authority of the risk, giving details of the respect in which the civil explosive was considered not to be in conformity with Part 13 of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and any corrective measures taken
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 53(2) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and (2) of, and paragraph 7(m) of Schedule 12 to, the Health and Safety at Work Act etc. 1974.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence applies from the 1st January 2021. For the offence applying before this date, see H20704.
